paragraphs: Issi ben Akiva; Chanina ben Akiva. In both names Hyman says it should read “ben Akavya.”[^1]

notes.text: “In both” refers contextually to the two preceding names, Issi ben Akiva and Chanina ben Akiva. Hyman directs that ben Akavya should be read in both; the directive is retained at its force rather than made a tentative possibility or independently verified correction. Akiva and Akavya remain different forms. None of these names has a separate personal title in this notice.
